services.desc: Ready to experience the thrill of South Padre parasailing? We offer convenient boarding locations across the island, including oceanside departures at Isla Grand Beach Resort and Margaritaville Hotel/Sapphire Condos, plus bayside flights at Tequila Sunset when conditions call for it. View our full boarding locations

services.name: Banana Boat Rides
services.desc: How much are banana boat rides in South Padre Island? Banana boat rides are $37 per person or $32 cash, plus tax. Where do banana boat rides launch from? Rides launch directly from the beach at select South Padre Island resort locations. How long is a banana boat ride? Rides operate on a 20-minute rotating schedule
